mission: Build a zero-cost Swiss legal research product: broad retrieval -> sourced AI answer -> query-specific visual map -> explicit counter-authority search, using OpenCaseLaw instead of rebuilding commoditized corpus infrastructure.

corpus.question: PAUSE — LEGACY CORPUS COMPLETE AND PRESERVED. The 174k corpus, section extraction, BGE/bger crosswalk and historical artifacts remain valid research evidence/fallback data, but are no longer on the MVP critical path. The canonical Swiss source for the new query-specific product is OpenCaseLaw public infrastructure. Re-open corpus only if the MVP exposes a concrete missing data capability that OpenCaseLaw cannot supply.

legal-distance.question: PAUSE — UNIVERSAL 174k LEGAL-GEOMETRY RESEARCH IS NO LONGER THE PRODUCT CRITICAL PATH. Preserve all accepted and negative results. Do not resume dense 174k embedding/citation-heritage work for the MVP. Re-open only if query-specific retrieval/map tests show a specific representation deficiency that cannot be solved with free lexical/citation/open-source methods.

fractal-map.question: PAUSE — GLOBAL 174k FRACTAL MAP AND BLOCKER_PRODUCT_JOIN_ALIGNMENT_V1 ARE SUPERSEDED AS MVP BLOCKERS. Preserve existing clustering/rendering code and artifacts for reuse, but do NOT spend cycles repairing the universal id→cluster join unless the query-specific product later requires it. Product may selectively reuse projection/clustering/WebGL/LOD components.

evaluation.question: QUERY-MAP MVP EVALUATION (canonical spec docs/product/QUERY_MAP_MVP.md). Build a small frozen evaluation set of real Swiss legal research queries and a zero-cost automated harness for the new product. Primary metrics: retrieval recall of known relevant authorities, recall of known limiting/contrary authorities where feasible, source validity, FR/DE/IT robustness, duplication, cached reproducibility, latency and cluster stability. Baseline = conventional OpenCaseLaw ranked search / answer+ranked-list where automatable. Explicitly test the independent adversarial retrieval pass. Do NOT use paid APIs, do NOT resurrect universal 174k geometry, and do NOT claim automated metrics prove UX usefulness. Produce ACCEPTED/REPRODUCED evidence that product can use immediately.

product.question: BUILD THE ZERO-COST QUERY-MAP MVP defined in docs/product/QUERY_MAP_MVP.md. This supersedes repair of the old global 174k product map. Immediate end-to-end target: user enters a Swiss legal question -> retrieve broadly from OpenCaseLaw public REST/MCP with caching -> free lexical/rule/open-source reranking -> generate a sourced AI answer using the currently healthy FREE OpenCode model/fallback -> run an INDEPENDENT counter-authority retrieval pass looking for contradictory/limiting/distinguishing/exception cases -> merge/deduplicate -> build a query-specific graph/map over ~100-300 decisions -> clickable browser UI showing clusters, outliers, decision details, relation/citation edges on selection, and a visible counter-authority emphasis/toggle. The same case may move between queries. 2D vs 3D is implementation-driven; visual usefulness matters, not 3D for its own sake. ZERO mandatory external spend: no paid LLM, embedding, reranking, vector DB, search or hosted inference API. Reuse existing LexMachina TF-IDF, clustering, WebGL/Canvas, LOD and navigation code only when it accelerates this MVP. Do NOT block on BLOCKER_PRODUCT_JOIN_ALIGNMENT_V1, dense 174k embeddings, the old citation-graph team, or universal fractal hierarchy. Acceptance: one-command/server launch; at least several real query fixtures; complete source-linked result bundles; adversarial pass visible in UI; tests for cache/retrieval/source validity; no paid dependency; clickable map usable locally. Then hand to human product gate rather than expanding R&D.

director_note: HUMAN PIVOT 2026-10-11: User explicitly redirected LexMachina back to its original research-product goal. Canonical target is now query-specific visual legal research, not a universal 174k legal geometry. OpenCaseLaw public REST/MCP is the default Swiss data infrastructure; mandatory external spend must be zero. Old corpus/global-map results are preserved but removed from the critical path. Product + evaluation RUN in parallel; corpus/legal-distance/fractal-map PAUSE. Legacy frontier-product-join-fix is superseded and must not block product. See docs/product/QUERY_MAP_MVP.md and LEXMACHINA_MASTER_PROMPT.md.
